facts.fact: The Autoridade Geral Aduaneira says electronic payment of customs declarations through participating banks, using a 20-digit reference, entered operation on 1 September 2026, with electronic channels mandatory from 1 October 2026.
facts.system: AGA electronic payment of customs declarations

systems.platform: participating banks, 20-digit reference on Boletim de Liquidacao
